The erosion caused by the outward creep of the [[Realm of Torment]] has eaten away at the very foundations of this forgotten citadel, dropping much of it into a vast sinkhole. It is said the lone living witness to the [[Margonite]] assault on the [[Gates of Heaven]] and [[Abaddon]]'s defeat at the hands of the [[Gods of Tyria|Five Gods]] still resides here, all but abandoned to the mists of time.}} [[Lair of the Forgotten]] is a long-forgotten and thoroughly-destroyed ancestral home of the [[Forgotten]]. It lies close to the northern edges of [[the Desolation]]. ==Getting there== This outpost is entirely optional.
